mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during such triggers (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly UNRATE falls below 7%, labor market slack increases, reducing expected wage growth and depressing S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant during such UNRATE conditions (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST (household spending index) of at least 3% predicts a positive S&P 20-day forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥3% in the current month relative to prior month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return in 5 consecutive such months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of more than 2% indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with a negative S&P 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >2% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during such INDPRO declines (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 show simultaneous monthly increases, the combination signals dual accommodative and demand signals, predicting a positive S&P 5-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS ↑ and GDPC1 ↑ in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 10 such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS (employment months) below 130,000 suggests labor market tightness, which precedes a negative S&P 60-day forward return in contractionary regimes.
regime_hint: Early signs of labor market tightening
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative or not statistically significant during such events (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS (retail sales index) of at least 4% indicate weakening retail demand, which is associated with a negative S&P 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by ≥4% in the current month relative to prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during such declines (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where CPIAUCSL (CPI) exceeds 233, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to the anticipation of future rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative or not significantly different from zero when CPIAUCSL > 233 (p > 0.05).
